medical_disclaimer.subtitulo: Critical information about using this application
medical_disclaimer.aviso_texto: This application does NOT replace professional medical consultation. Results are for informational and educational purposes only.
medical_disclaimer.proposito_contenido:
The "Fertility Calculator AI" is an educational tool designed to:

• Provide general fertility estimates
• Help identify factors that may influence
• Educate about reproductive health
• Facilitate conversations with medical professionals

It is NOT designed to:
• Diagnose medical conditions
• Replace medical examinations
• Provide medical treatment
• Guarantee pregnancy results
medical_disclaimer.limitaciones_contenido:
Calculations are based on:
• General probabilistic algorithms
• Average population data
• Self-reported information
• Limited available factors

They do NOT consider:
• Complex medical conditions
• Complete medical history
• Specific genetic factors
• Unique individual circumstances
medical_disclaimer.recomendaciones_contenido:
ALWAYS consult with a qualified medical professional:

• Before making reproductive decisions
• For interpretation of laboratory results
• If you have fertility concerns
• For personalized family planning
• If you experience concerning symptoms
medical_disclaimer.responsabilidad_contenido:
The developers of this application are NOT responsible for:

• Medical decisions based solely on app results
• Diagnostic delays from relying on app estimates
• Consequences of not seeking professional medical attention
• Treatment outcomes based on app information
• Losses or damages arising from application use

Medical responsibility lies exclusively with licensed healthcare professionals.
medical_disclaimer.emergencias_contenido:
If you experience severe fertility-related symptoms:

• Severe pelvic pain
• Heavy abnormal bleeding
• Ectopic pregnancy symptoms
• Adverse treatment reactions

SEEK IMMEDIATE MEDICAL ATTENTION
Do not use this application for medical emergencies.
medical_disclaimer.base_cientifica_contenido:
The algorithms are based on:

• Peer-reviewed medical literature
• Reproductive society guidelines
• Published epidemiological data
• International medical consensus

However, medical science constantly evolves.
Algorithms may not reflect the most recent advances.
medical_disclaimer.restriccion_edad_contenido:
This application is rated for users 17+ years due to:

• Specialized medical content about reproduction
• Information about fertility and sexuality
• Advanced medical terminology
• Sensitive reproductive health topics

Minors should use the application under adult supervision and medical consultation.
medical_disclaimer.recomendacion_final_contenido:
Use this application as an initial educational tool.

For real medical decisions, ALWAYS consult with:
• Gynecologists specialized in reproduction
• Certified fertility centers
• Reproductive endocrinologists

Your reproductive health deserves specialized professional medical care.
medical_disclaimer.footer_aviso:
This medical notice is an integral part of the terms of use.
By using the application, you accept these limitations and recommendations.

bibliography.introduccion: This application is based on peer-reviewed scientific literature and international clinical guidelines to provide accurate and up-to-date fertility estimates.
bibliography.actualizacion_continua: This bibliography is continuously updated to reflect the latest advances in reproductive medicine and maintain the accuracy of calculation algorithms.
bibliography.acerca_referencias_contenido: The algorithms of this application are based on peer-reviewed medical literature and international clinical guidelines. The references listed here represent the scientific evidence that supports our calculations.
bibliography.metodologia_contenido:
The algorithms of this application were developed through:

1. **Systematic review** of current medical literature
2. **Metadata analysis** of multicenter studies
3. **Clinical validation** with real cases
4. **Continuous updating** based on new evidence
5. **Peer review** by specialist physicians

The methodology ensures that calculations reflect current scientific consensus in assisted reproduction.
bibliography.limitaciones_evidencia_contenido:
It is important to recognize that:

• Medical studies have inherent limitations
• Results may vary between populations
• Evidence constantly evolves
• Individual cases may differ from averages
• Some factors are not completely characterized

Therefore, application results are estimates and require professional medical interpretation.
